author: BoldAndBrash
body:
This isn't necessarily my idea, the staff and community have wanted it, but it's never been carried out from what I know. Thought I'd go ahead and see what the rest of you guys thinks. \o/


The community gets to vote for X amount of representatives, people who are the voice of the community. During certain meetings, the staff will allow the representatives to enter the meeting and give the input of the community. The ideas would be discussed with the representatives just like a regular meeting.

Opinions?

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
Why not just stream the meeting instead and take the opinions of the community from the twitch chat instead of having an exact amount of people to vote for the whole community.
In the end you also get a saved meeting which lasts a week or more I believe thus allowing a week or a bit more for the staff members who missed the meeting to actually review it and saving all of your times to having to upload a sound version each week?
And if you guys really want to keep the meeting you can always download & re-upload it.
Would leave it much more organized and have other moderators be the "moderators" on the twitch stream giving out punishments on the twitch stream to whoever is trolling.
Would be much more efficient on your parts

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
We shouldn't need representatives to speak on behalf of the community.
If people want to speak to the staff, they can do it themselves. 

Communication between the staff team and the community needs to be promoted more. 
We shouldn't need meetings if everyone in the staff team and in the community is well-informed of what's going on.
